description: This pie chart visually compares two categories: “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment,” illustrating the proportion of time cost attributed to each. The chart contains two slices: the larger, orange slice labeled “Reduction” accounts for 69.92% of the total, while the smaller, blue slice labeled “Efficient deployment” represents 30.08%. Both percentage values are explicitly displayed within their respective slices. The “Efficient deployment” slice is visually offset or exploded from the rest of the pie, drawing attention to it. There is no legend present, as the labels are directly associated with their corresponding segments. The segments are arranged in descending order of size, with “Reduction” occupying the majority of the chart.
caption_used: Efficient deployment methods significantly reduce the time cost, with the average total time cost before efficient deployment being 92.5s (30.5s + 62s). This represents a reduction of approximately 72.5% after efficient deployment, highlighting the substantial impact of optimization strategies.
